name: DeepSeek
note: Quota only, and a balance rather than a meter: DeepSeek is pay-per-use and publishes no cap, so there is no percentage to report. One row per currency the account holds — the currency is read from the response rather than assumed, because Chinese accounts are billed in CNY and labelling that with a dollar sign would misstate the balance by an exchange rate. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is read when Antarium is launched from a shell; an app started from Finder inherits no environment, so a key set in a shell profile will not be seen. A textFile or jsonFile credential works either way.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live account.

quota.setupHint: Put your platform.deepseek.com API key in this file: replace quota.credential with {"kind":"textFile","path":"~/.deepseek-key"}, or set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and launch Antarium from a terminal.
